notes.title: Glyph Bomb - build it with symbols during combat. Match boss glyphs!
notes.content: [h3]I’ve added a super weapon to the game. During battle, you can observe which symbols the current monsters are made of, open the bomb editor, enter it symbol by symbol - and boom. The more matches with boss symbols, the stronger the damage. You can use it once per location.[/h3][previewyoutube="swYxFT0TDB8;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]Fixed bugs and already added a ton of new stuff. In two or three weeks, I’ll launch Playtest #2.[/h3][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Playtest is live!
notes.content: [h3]From July 9 to 14, you can try out the latest build and help shape the combat system.[/h3][h3]The main goal: to see how well the gameplay feels in action.[/h3][h3]Honest feedback is super welcome![/h3]

notes.title: Battle on the Sea of Electrolysis
notes.content:
[h3]Once, a massive aluminum plant stood on its shores. Now, only the sea’s name recalls the industrial boom of the past. And, of course, the corrosive and nasty bubbles that still lurk here.
[/h3]

[previewyoutube=ilabS55jcv0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]I’ve created a battle in the game’s very first location. Despite being turn-based, you can time your shots for better accuracy. A little real-time twist.
[/h3]

notes.title: A planet with locations for the demo version. Playtesting begins in February!
notes.content:
[h3]Only fragments of a signal in the form of text symbols convey the tragic events from the distant space colony “Last Hope.” I've created a planet with locations for the demo version.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=XSgK7sWE_0U;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Non-combat Locations + Gamepad Support
notes.content:
[h2]Created a few non-combat locations.[/h2]
[h3]1. Smugglers' Glade in Effulgence. Here, you can buy essentials and pick up quests in any of the four huts. Does it seem appealing?[/h3]

[previewyoutube=JRCxTCWtIQo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]2. The Chill and Skill. Staying there slowly restores HP. Check into the hotel for an instant 100% HP recovery. All objects in the game are fragile shells barely containing the chaos of text symbols, so full recovery means breakdown & reassembly.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=Axo0bQ40WjY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]3. Testing gamepad support (+Steam Deck) for the items printing screen in my game Effulgence. To print an item, you need its schematic and enough resources. Some item schematics have duplication protection - only one copy can be printed. However, there are places where this protection can be hacked.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=ePXWlHFfrWE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Thanks![/h3]

notes.title: Turn-based battle system
notes.content:
[h3]Created a turn-based battle on motorcycles (+ a combat sparrow). Does it look interesting? What could be improved?[/h3]

[previewyoutube=o7AKIipx418;full][/previewyoutube]

★ Each character can have a pet. In the video, it's a battle sparrow. The pet can be commanded to attack an enemy, shield its owner by taking the fire, or hide behind the owner.

★ Each character has several item slots. These can hold blasters, shields, injectors, grenades, and much more. To take a hero's turn, you need to select items, their action, and the target.

Please don't forget to add the game to your wishlist and sign up for the playtest. I'll do my best to launch the playtest in January!
